InfoText: This is the initial version of Black Hole. The application is ready to use, all main functions work. The project will develop!
StoryText: My story began in childhood, when I seriously dreamed of becoming a programmer, and I became one. I started learning C# in August 2024 and continue to this day. I'm inspired by many people such as: Pavel Durov, Steve Jobs, Elon Musk, Albert Einstein. I started writing my first programs following guides, and it was very interesting and exciting. Later I tried to take on a project that would come later, which was very strange and, honestly, a mistake. This project is very complex, I won't say which one yet, but it will definitely be released. In programming, I faced many difficulties, first of all, the code in the project is not entirely mine, which might be normal for developers, but for me it's not good. AI helped me with what I didn't understand, and that's how my product came to be. I can sequence actions and set tasks, I can think algorithmically, but writing code is my weakness. I also often have projects in IDE, and when I first encountered this, I was angry and created a new project. Sometimes I spent a long time looking for errors and spent a lot of time on small things, but overall it's the programmer's foundation. I worked alone, or practically with AI. My first victories were simple programs, a calculator that I wrote myself was a breakthrough for me, and many other small programs. Also, here's my first serious project - Black Hole, below I wrote how it was conceived and how it came to be. So, let's continue below.
ProjectText: Black Hole came from one of my problems: when I was creating that complex project that I never finished, I had a problem - I couldn't write code and save it because my C drive was completely full of temporary files and other files, etc. So I thought, maybe I should make a so-called computer manager that would help with components, because when you try to understand computers deeply, it's somehow time-consuming and scary for some people, what if you break the system and everything crashes. So I did it. I started with simple statistics of main components: processor, RAM, disks, and of course graphics card, though I haven't fully implemented it yet, that's for future updates, I'll try to add all other possible components. Then I started making settings, and in the end it turned out, in my opinion, very beautiful and interesting. Also, there will be panels later, as I call them, like tests, history, etc. Black Hole turned out unoptimized with lots of unnecessary code, I'll try to fix this with updates, since I'm not very experienced yet, but I really like this project, I'm proud of this first application.
PhilosophyText: Here I'll talk about myself in detail from my philosophy. Honestly, I don't know how to say it, not that much, so I'll write in one text without separating. So, I believe that programming is a place where I can show my world, you can solve many problems with computers, which people have been doing for the last 20-40 years. But we've come so far that neural networks have appeared. I have a good attitude towards them now, I don't know why some people say that AI will take over the world soon, etc., maybe in the future, but that's still nonsense. Right now AI is just a ready-made answer to your queries, so that's it. Well, even if we advance that far, code is written by people, and I think people have reason. Now let's talk about freedom: I'm for free internet, but unfortunately, this internet is shrinking everywhere in all countries. I'm certainly very upset that every action will be tracked and controlled. On one hand, I understand government needs, but on the other hand, it's too much. Well, in general, the internet has changed, it's not like it was in the 2010s-2020s, and maybe we can't get that back. Also about persistence: I consider myself a persistent person, maybe it doesn't show externally, but when working on Black Hole it was exactly like that, I didn't give up even with such bugs when it was unclear. About my work I can say this: I try to work hard, but also not to forget about rest, and I myself am a kind, calm person, possibly stress-resistant, and goal-oriented, and ambitious.
SkillsDescription: Technologies I've mastered and use in development:
SkillsText: Well, as you already know, I studied C#, I can't write fully, but only some simple programs. Also, creating Black Hole, I understand WPF, and WinApi is an API that requests information about components, that's it. I wrote this in Visual Studio 2022. I plan to master encryption, network stuff, game development, like blockchain and low-level programming, algorithms, databases, and maybe something else. And I forgot to say, I'm thinking about learning a new programming language later, thinking about Python, Go, SQL, C++, JavaScript, and that's all for now.
DreamsText: So, here's possibly the most interesting part for you - dreams and plans. Let's start with dreams: I really want to meet Pavel Durov and talk with him), yes, also visit many countries and many others. And the plans are: by December I plan to release a game, again I won't say which one, and I also plan to make my portfolio website and then that very project that I've been trying to make, very complex, but it must be implemented. Well, that's all for now, that's it! Enjoy using Black Hole, if anything, write to me in feedback everything you think and want to tell me about ideas or anything else, leave an email and I'll answer you 📩.

ThankYouText: Your support inspires me to new achievements! 💫
FinalThanks: Thank you for using Black Hole! You make this project special. 🚀
